title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey; 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(TDK MA-90)(FOB) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > Panasonic 3800 DAT (internal A/D conversion) > Soundforge (editing) > CD Architect > Mitsui disc > Toast 9 > Xact

ai_review.summary: Exceptional audience recording that rivals top soundboard tapes, capturing one of the Dead’s all‑time great shows.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave that this audience (AUD) recording is virtually on par with the best soundboard sources, noting its warmth and clarity. The performance itself is hailed as one of the band’s finest ever, delivering high energy throughout the concert.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both an outstanding show and a near‑soundboard‑quality audience recording, indicating extremely high overall value.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best AUD of this show, warmer than many recordings and nearly on par with top SBD tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not specifically detailed, but implied to be consistently strong throughout.
